title: Trace ideals and uniserial modules
summary: We thoroughly investigate the trace ideals of projective modules over the endomorphism ring of a uniserial module. After the work of Dubrovin and Puninski, it is known that this class of rings provides examples of trace ideals of projective right modules that are not trace ideals of projective left modules. In this paper we further investigate when this happens, giving an intrinsic description of such trace ideals and their properties.
